notes.title: Monolith’s Dreamers at PlaySorbonneFestival 2025!
notes.content:
🎮 Monolith’s Dreamers at PlaySorbonneFestival 2025!

[hr][/hr]Hello everyone!


We’re excited to share some great news with you: Monolith’s Dreamers will be playable at PlaySorbonneFestival 2025! 🎉
It’s the perfect opportunity to try out the game in person, chat with us, and dive deeper into the mysterious universe we’ve been building over the past months.


[hr][/hr]

✅ Event details:
📅 When? Saturday, September 20, 2025
⏰ Opening hours: 10 AM – 7 PM (public)
📍 Where? Sorbonne University – Pierre and Marie Curie Campus, 4 Place Jussieu, Paris 5e
💸 How much? Free (registration required)
🔗 Register here


[hr][/hr]


Thank you once again for all your support since the demo 💜
We can’t wait to meet you, share this moment together, and let you experience Monolith’s Dreamers in person.



See you soon in the ruins 🌀
— The Dev Team



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308565/e4f1d33a6e9a228e69c0dbe9b9a276c14dc81fc9.png"]

notes.title: 🛠️ Devlog #1 - 07/28
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


Development on Monolith’s Dreamers is moving along nicely, and we wanted to share a little behind-the-scenes update with you! 🌟


🎬 Cutscenes are coming together!
We’re continuing to integrate new narrative sequences, and while we're at it, we’re giving the older ones a well-deserved visual upgrade: improved effects, cleaner dialogue displays… all to better immerse you in the story.


👁️‍🗨️ A mysterious new enemy appears…
We won’t say too much just yet, but get ready to encounter a creature that’s as strange as it is unforgettable. You’ve been warned...


🌑 A brand-new level just completed!
Darkness surrounds you, and every step becomes a puzzle. Expect a unique atmosphere, full of tension and discovery. (Here’s a little sneak peek 👇)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308565/e967e068476f6e3f72ea4f8cebcb45a6aae3868e.png"]

Thank you so much for your support, feedback, and kindness since the demo 💜
We’ve got a lot more to show you in the coming weeks, so stay tuned…



See you soon in the ruins of Monolith’s Dreamers 🌀



— The development team

notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update & What’s Next!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!


First of all, a huge thank you for all the amazing feedback following the release of the demo. Your messages, observations, and enthusiasm mean the world to us and help us improve the experience day by day. 🙏

Here’s what we’ve recently fixed/improved in the demo:


✅ Recent Updates:
🔧 Fixed a bug that prevented the proper functioning of post-processing effects

🚀 Optimized shader preloading to reduce loading times

🎬 Improved visuals and transitions in the introductory story level S-0

👁️ Fixed an issue where highlighted objects weren’t displayed with the correct activation state in Focus Mode

🌍 Minor changes to the English translation

⚡ The energy tooltip for the slab requiring energy should now appear when the player is nearby

🪨 Added environmental decorations to story level S-2


[hr][/hr]

🔮 June-july roadmap?
To keep you in the loop on how development is progressing, here’s a quick look at our roadmap for the coming weeks:

🗺️ Improved map interface

🎥 Graphical fix for the intro cutscene

🐞 Continued bug fixing

✂️ Integration of Chapter 3 cutscenes

🖼️ Improved murals for the intro sequence



Thank you again for your support, feedback, and kindness.


We’re moving forward step by step, and we can’t wait to show you even more very soon!
In the meantime, don’t hesitate to keep sharing your thoughts, they truly help us shape the game.

See you soon in the ruins of Monolith’s Dreamers 🌀



— The development team
